verdict.rationale: Foreloop provides a dashboard showing agent status ('last thing it said') and mentions approving 'big calls from your phone', implying some notification/approval flow, but there is no explicit documentation of push/email/Slack notifications when a task completes or needs input. missing for 10: explicit notification channel (email/Slack/push) documentation, confirmation of real-time alerts rather than manual dashboard polling, evidence of notification content for 'needs input' events.
